notes: const { header, body } = await decodePNG(bytes); width and height from header, RGBA bytes from body. Pure TypeScript; inflates through the runtime's DecompressionStream. decodePNG transfers (detaches) the ArrayBuffer of its input and reuses it for the pixels, and refuses a view into a larger or pooled buffer, so the adapter passes new Uint8Array(bytes), a copy of the file made inside each call.
